title: Mike McGlone: Gold Could Crash Below $3,000 as Stocks Collapse
speaker: Mike McGlone (Bloomberg Intelligence)

macro_themes.view: A ~5% guaranteed Treasury yield is a huge headwind for non-income-producing assets like metals and crypto, and for stocks.
Metals, copper, crypto and yields are highly correlated to an extremely expensive US stock market; a 10-20% S&P drop would drag them all down.
The energy crisis plus central bank hiking will give way to a normal disinflation cycle, likely triggered by a stock market decline.
Expects a midterm sweep against the party in power, a tilt away from the Iran war and lower energy prices, a headwind for gold and energy.
Treasuries, especially longer duration, are the high-probability performer; yields could drop a couple hundred basis points.

calls.reason: Most expensive stock market vs GDP in 100 years, 5% Treasuries competing, overdue for a 10-20% correction that stays down a while.
calls.quote: When the the first time we're going to get 10% correction, it'll happen... if we get a 20% correction, that will happen.

calls.condition: Consensus 4,000 support likely breaks; deeper fall tied to a stock market decline
calls.reason: Gold volatility 2.2x S&P, high correlation to stocks, 5% yields; 60-month/10-year moving averages just below 3,000 usually get revisited.
calls.quote: the long-term moving averages, 60-month 10-year are basically just below 3,000. Almost always go back to those levels

calls.reason: Silver breaking below 60, volatility highest vs S&P since 1980; long-term moving averages in the 30s.
calls.quote: I think silver definitely has a date with 50, the old highs.

calls.reason: Copper's 50-week correlation to S&P is the highest ever on the way up; a complete stock puppet that falls twice as much as stocks.

calls.condition: Faster if the war de-escalates after midterms or stocks swoon
calls.reason: Western hemisphere energy surplus; prices revert to ~$55 US cost of production, and oil lows near 40 come when stocks swoon.
calls.quote: I still fully expect crude oil is probably not going to bottom until they make a typical bottom around $40 a barrel.

calls.condition: If S&P has a 10-20% drawdown that stays down a while
calls.reason: High correlation and volatility vs S&P, crypto excess (unlimited supply of 'pigeons') still needs purging.
calls.quote: with a 20% correction S&P 500, it stays down a while, Bitcoin will go back is going to go back to $10,000.

calls.instrument_quoted: 10-year Treasury yield (also discussed via TLT and 5-year note)
calls.condition: Triggered by stock market reverting lower
calls.reason: Yields at 27-year extremes; TLT is a put on stocks with positive carry; government needs lower yields. Bullish TLT/Treasuries = bearish yields.
calls.quote: They'll just drop maybe a couple hundred basis points. To me, that's the next big trade.

notes: Recorded Oct 13 per speaker ('as we speak on October 13th'), published ~Oct 18. TNX call encodes his bullish TLT/Treasuries view; 'couple hundred bp' drop not converted into a numeric target. Gold 3,000 is a moving-average reversion level he expects price to revisit, used as long-term target. Admits being early/wrong on Treasuries and copper.
